senses.gloss: सं-लक्षण n. the act of distinctly marking, distinguishing, characterizing, W.
सं-˚लक्षित mfn. distinguished by a mark, marked, Pañcar.
observed, recognized, known, perceived, learnt, Kāv.; Kathās.
सं-˚लक्ष्य mfn. to be distinctly marked, distinguishable, perceptible, visible, Kpr.
सं-√ लग् Caus. -लागयति, to attach to, put or place firmly upon, KātyŚr., Sch.
सं-लग्न mfn. closely attached, adhering, being in contact with, sticking to or in, fallen into (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kathās.
fighting hand to hand (du. said of two combatants), MBh.
(ifc.) proceeding from or out of Pañcar.
सं-√ लङ्घ् P. Ā. -लङ्घति, ˚ते, to leap over or beyond, pass by or away (see below).
सं-लङ्घन n. passing away (of time), Lāṭy., Sch.
सं-लङ्घित mfn. passed away, gone by, Lāṭy.
सं-√ लज्ज् Ā. -लज्जते (only pr. p. -लज्जमान), to be thoroughly ashamed or embarrassed, R.

सं-√ लप् P. -लपति, to talk together, chat, converse, Daś.; HPariś. :
Pass. -लप्यते, to be spoken of or to, be called or named, Sarvad. :
Caus. See ˚लापित below.
सं-लपन n. the act of talking or chattering together
सं-लप˚नोष्णता f. desire of talking much, Suśr.
सं-लप्तक mfn. affable, gentle, civil, Buddh.
सं-लाप m. (ifc. f(आ). ) talking together, familiar or friendly conversation, discourse with (instr. with and without सह, or gen.) or about (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(in dram.) a kind of dialogue (passionless, but full of manly sentiments, e.g. Mcar. ii, 34), Bhas.
सं-˚लापक m. a kind of dialogue (= prec.), Bhar.
सं-˚लापक n. a species of minor drama (said to be of a controversial kind), Sāh.
सं-˚लापित mfn. (fr. Caus.) spoken to, addressed, Hit.
सं-˚लापिन् mfn. discoursing, conversing, ib.
सं-लब्ध mfn. taken hold of, obtained, Kathās.
सं-लिप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) desirous of seizing or taking hold of MBh.
सं-लय , ˚यन. See सं-√ ली.
सं-लय॑ m. settling or sitting down, alighting or settling (of a bird), ŚBr.
sleep, L.
melting away, dissolution (= प्र-लय), MW.
सं-√ लल् Caus. -लालयति√ to caress, fondle, treat tenderly, BhP.
सं-˚लालित mfn. caressed, fondled, MW.
सं-˚लिखित mfn. scratched &c. (used in AV. vii, 50, 5 to express some act in gambling).
सं-लेख m. strict abstinence, Buddh.
सं-√ लिह् (cf. सं-√ रिह्) P. -लेढि, -लिहति (pr. p. Ā. -लिहान), to lick up, devour, enjoy, Kāṭh.; MBh.; Bhaṭṭ.
सं-लीढ mfn. licked up, licked, enjoyed, MW.
सं-˚लयन n. sitting or lying down, Cat.
the act of clinging or adhering to, MW.
dissolution, ib.
सं-लीन mfn. clinging or joined together, adhering or clinging to (loc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
entered into (loc.), MBh.
hidden, concealed, cowered, cowering down, lurking in (loc.), MBh.; R.
contracted, Suśr.
सं-लीन—कर्ण mfn. one whose ears are depressed or hang down, Pañcat.
सं-लीन—मानस mfn. drooping or depressed in mind, Hariv.
सं-लोडन mfn. disturbing, throwing into confusion (comp.), MBh.
सं-लोडन n. the act of disturbing or agitating or confusing, MW.

सं-√ लुप् P. -लुम्पति, -लुप्यति, to rend or tear to pieces, tear away, pull away, AV.; ŚBr. :
Caus. -लोपयति, to destroy, efface, MBh.
सं-लुलित mfn. (√ लुल्) agitated, disordered, confused, R.
come into contact with (comp.), Caurap. (‘smeared with’ Sch.)
सं-लेप m. mud, dirt, Hcat.
सं-√ लोक् Ā. -लोकते, to look together, look at each other (with उभयतः), AitBr.
सं-लोकिन् mfn. being in view of others, observed by others, Gobh.
